subject: Request: SOC2 evidence & encryption deep-dive — scheduling and artifact plan
messages:
From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@solarahealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Solara Health Procurement <procurement@solarahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC2 evidence and architecture deep-dive

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. Solara Health is preparing for our SOC 2 Type II and the security team wants a focused architecture review to confirm how Redwood handles the following items:

- SSO/SAML metadata and authentication flow (IdP/SCIM expectations)
- Encryption at rest and in transit (KMS integration, key rotation cadence)
- Audit logging and retention (where logs live, access controls, export formats)
- Evidence mapping for SOC 2 (what artifacts you can provide and timelines)

Could we schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive the week of April 5? Our preferred windows are Apr 5–7: mornings PT or early afternoons PT. I attached our initial evidence request (solara_evidence_request_v1.pdf) with specific artifact examples to help guide the discussion.

Attendees from my side: myself (security lead), our IAM engineer, and procurement on the call for timelines. Please include whoever from Redwood should attend (architecture/security/ops).

If you can share a 2–3 item pre-read or checklist ahead of the meeting that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Emma Jensen
Security Lead – Solara Health
emma.jensen@solarahealth.com
(415) 555-1298

Attachment: solara_evidence_request_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence and architecture deep-dive

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the attachment, I reviewed the PDF. Happy to set up the deep-dive.

Proposed 60-min slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 6, 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Wed Apr 7, 10:00–11:00 AM PT

I'll include Soojin Lee (security engineer) on the invite — she can speak to KMS and encryption details. Monica (CS lead) will join for evidence handoff and timelines.

Can you confirm who will be the primary technical attendee from Solara (IAM engineer or platform lead)? Also, do you want procurement on the call or a separate commercial follow-up?

I'll prepare a short agenda and a 1–page artifact checklist as a pre-read.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@solarahealth.com>

Cc: Solara Health Procurement <procurement@solarahealth.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence and architecture deep-dive

Mina — confirmed: our IAM engineer (James Park) and platform lead (Nina Alvarez) will attend. Procurement asked to be cc'd so they can put a meeting hold if needed.

We prefer Tue Apr 6, 2:00–3:00 PM PT. Adding AWS Marketplace to the thread because procurement is also evaluating a marketplace listing schedule.

Two quick asks for the pre-read:
1) If you can include a short note on encryption key rotation policy and whether customers can bring their own key (BYOK).
2) Example SAML metadata and SCIM provisioning expectations (a sample metadata XML is fine).

I've attached an availability grid (availability_grid.xlsx) with our team constraints.

Thanks — see you on Apr 6 unless we hear otherwise.

Emma

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: SOC2 architecture deep-dive — Tue Apr 6, 2:00–3:00 PM PT

Hi all,

Thanks — Apr 6, 2:00–3:00 PM PT is booked. Calendar invite will show Redwood dial-in + Zoom.

Agenda (60 min):
- 0–10 min: Introductions and objectives (Mina / Emma)
- 10–30 min: Architecture walkthrough — SSO, SCIM, and auth flows (Soojin)
- 30–45 min: Encryption & KMS (Evelyn) — at-rest, in-transit, BYOK options
- 45–55 min: Audit logging and evidence formats (Monica)
- 55–60 min: Next steps and artifact delivery timelines

Pre-read / artifacts I uploaded: redwood_pre-read.pdf (high-level checklist + sample SAML metadata), and the draft agenda (soc2-arch-agenda.docx). Preview: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-pre-read

Please reply if you need a different dial-in format.

Subject: RE: Confirmed: SOC2 architecture deep-dive — scheduling conflict and alternative slots

Hi Emma and team — quick update: an urgent postmortem review just popped onto Soojin's calendar for Apr 6, and she is a required attendee for the encryption/KMS section. To keep the session effective I'd like to propose rescheduling by one or two days.

Alternate 60-min options (PT):
- Wed Apr 7, 9:00–10:00 AM PT
- Thu Apr 8, 11:00–12:00 PM PT

If neither of those work we can keep Apr 6 and I will have Evelyn cover Soojin's portion with detailed notes and follow-up Q&A in a shorter separate sync.

Checklist of artifacts we'll bring and the expected delivery format:
- SAML metadata sample (XML) — immediate (in pre-read)
- SCIM provisioning schema notes (PDF) — immediate
- KMS integration doc + rotation policy (PDF) — during call and post-call artifact drop
- Audit log schema and retention policy (CSV export examples) — post-call within 3 business days
- SOC 2 evidence mapping (list of control artifacts and sample reports) — post-call within 5 business days

Please confirm preferred alternate slot and whether procurement still needs to join the same meeting or a separate follow-up.

Apologies for the shuffle — we want the right SMEs on the call.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Sr Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
